decision_summary: The two sampled database-audit rows were reopened against packet database snapshots, final artifacts, article metadata, source text, supplementary text, and gate/rework artifacts. VAL0104 is correctly preserved as a source_conflict for a broad DRAMP pNP-43d activity/anticancer annotation with source-located MIC evidence, but the same pNP-43d scope exposes a repairable layer-3 defect: the accepted mechanism ontology contains a non-standard evidence_class. VAL0108 is confirmed as a literature-link citation row. Because non-standard mechanism evidence classes in accepted outputs are hard rework under the review prompt, the paper-level decision is needs_targeted_rework.

sample_row_decisions.evidence_summary: Layer 1 database status is caution-preserving: DRAMP35799 row 4 states broad Antimicrobial/Anticancer activity for pNP-43d with no assay, target, value, or unit, and the final database record preserves this as source_conflict rather than source_verified. Article metadata confirms the paper DOI/PMID/PMCID. Layer 2 support exists for the matched pNP-43d MIC row: figs7_pnp_43d_ecoli_wt_mic reports MIC 32 ug/mL against Escherichia coli ATCC 25922 with a Figure S7 locator and unit context. The sampled row becomes repairable because the pNP-43d-related mechanism ontology also contains accepted claim mech-002 with non-standard evidence_class mechanism_context_inferred_from_resistance_and_sar; the allowed ontology requires a standard class such as inferred_mechanism while preserving the source-bounded limitation.
cautions: DRAMP broad Antimicrobial/Anticancer labels are not promoted to primary-source verified assay evidence.
DRAMP compact sequence/modification notation for pNP-43d remains a preserved source_conflict.
A549 primary source context supports toxicity/non-toxicity reporting rather than clean anticancer efficacy.
The pNP-43d activity row is source-located, but the pNP-43d mechanism ontology needs evidence_class vocabulary repair.
